ezekiel.28.p1.b1.text: I am a god; I sit in the seat of gods in the heart of the sea.

ezekiel.28.p1.b2.text: Yet you are a man and not a god, though you have regarded your heart as that of a god.

ezekiel.28.p1.b3.text: By your great skill in trading you have increased your wealth, but your heart has grown proud because of it.

ezekiel.28.p1.b4.text: I will bring foreigners against you, the most ruthless of nations

ezekiel.28.p1.b5.text: Will you still say, ‘I am a god,’ in the presence of those who slay you?

ezekiel.28.p2.b1.text: Son of man, take up a lament for the king of Tyre

ezekiel.28.p2.b2.text: You were the seal of perfection, full of wisdom and perfect in beauty. … You were in Eden, the garden of God. Every kind of precious stone adorned you

ezekiel.28.p2.b3.text: you walked among the fiery stones.

ezekiel.28.p2.b4.text: Your heart grew proud of your beauty; you corrupted your wisdom because of your splendor; so I cast you to the earth

ezekiel.28.p2.b5.text: I reduced you to ashes on the ground in the eyes of all who saw you.

ezekiel.28.p2.b6.text: And there they will dwell securely, build houses, and plant vineyards.
